title: Cleo hero — cross-grid dither portrait
note: Her own screen recording of the Cleo site hero, labelled by her as visual/motion inspo. A figure rendered as a dense grid of small plus/cross marks over a warm gradient field; marks near the cursor scatter, stretch and trail, then settle back into the figure. What she specifically likes: how it uses an abstract visual to symbolise a human — the person is never drawn or photographed. Her adaptation: a hand-drawn mark grid, her portrait or pigeon, for Play or a hero only. No link on record.
